chunks: May God forgive you. Why did you allow them (to stay behind) without ascertaining who spoke the truth and who were liars?
ai.seo_question: Why did God question the Prophet for allowing people to stay behind in Surah At-Tawbah?
ai.summary: In the context of the Expedition of Tabuk, this verse (9:43) serves as a divine rebuke to the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) for granting permission to the hypocrites (Munafiqun) to remain behind, illustrating the principle of 'Afw' (divine pardon) for minor errors in judgment. Shia scholars emphasize that this was not a sin but a momentary lapse in discernment, highlighting the balance between mercy and the necessity of verifying sincerity (Sidq) against deceit (Kidhb) among the companions.
